title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.9.3
body_markdown:
*released Mar 12th, 2024*

### Summary of What's New in this Release of Visual Studio 2022 version 17.9.3

* VS now includes MAUI 8.0.7 (SR2); see here [Release 8.0.7 Â· dotnet/maui (github.com)](https://github.com/dotnet/maui/releases/tag/8.0.7) for the release notes.
* Fixed a CLI bug where the compiler would crash when compiling a static initonly array.
* Updating the Windows 11 SDK (10.0.22621.0) installed by Visual Studio to the February 2024 servicing build.

### Developer Community

* [Web.Config invalid after using Visual Studio 2022 Preview](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/WebConfig-invalid-after-using-Visual-St/10555985)
* [launch.vs.json does not support comments](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/launchvsjson-does-not-support-commen/10482769)
* [Update of extension doesn't start with Extension Manager UI Refresh](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Update-of-extension-doesnt-start-with-E/10525249)
* [SQL72025 after upgrading to Visual Studio 2022 17.9.0](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/SQL72025-after-upgrading-to-Visual-Studi/10584742)
* [Property Designer for .NET Framework Projects Don't Always Load](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/WinForms-NET-Framework:-project-propert/10585969)

### Security advisories addressed

* [**CVE-2024-21392**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-21392) A vulnerability exists in .NET where specially crafted requests may cause a resource leak, leading to a Denial of Service.
* [**CVE-2024-26190**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-26190) A Vulnerability exist in MsQuic.dll which might result in a peer to allocate small chunks of memory as long as connection stays alive.
* [**CVE-2023-27911**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-27911) This advisory is being republished to indicate that AutodeskÂ® FBXÂ® SDK is no longer supported in Visual Studio 2022.
